messages:
maya-cs: Heads up — Quantico (enterprise, security-heavy) wants to push a customer-facing feature using a 13B custom model. They need private infra, PHI redaction, and assurance on hallucination rates before renewal. Can we scope an intake + eval plan?

julie-cs: thanks maya. renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, so we should prioritize. Do we have their dataset size & latency SLOs?

maya-cs: they sent a sample bundle (5k records, mix of synthetic PHI and real). Latency target: p95 < 400ms, burst up to 50 rps. They want on-prem or VPC deployment.

sam-eng: @julie-cs @maya-cs okay — from runtime POV 13B on-prem is doable but we need quantization profile + memory estimates. I'll ask infra for a bench matrix: 8xA10G vs 4xA100, and baseline perf using our 13B-quant profile.

nora-privacy: moving to privacy side: we need to confirm PHI handling. Request: encryption-at-rest + HSM for keys, and a strict redaction eval. Can we get redaction recall/precision numbers from a probe eval?

maya-cs: they agreed to HSM and are ok with extra attestation. I'll collect the SOC/PCI checklist items.

sam-eng: I'll spin a minimal harness. Plan: 1) run 1k-sample gen and redaction probe, 2) run hallucination eval vs gold summaries (we should get their gold labels), 3) perf bench at target sequence lengths. Quick snippet for the harness config: 
```
model: quantico-13b-cust-v1
quant: int8_mixed
batching: auto
seq_len: 512
metrics: [latency_p95, token_cost, redaction_recall, rougeL]
```

julie-cs: timeline? we need to present to account and legal by EOD Fri.

sam-eng: rough ETA: bench + redaction probe in 48 hours if infra queue is clear. Might need dedicated capacity for stable perf numbers.

nora-privacy: For redaction probe, send me the sample annotations. I'll run privacy tests and a simple leakage scan. Also need to confirm data residency — they require EU-only processing for certain customers.

maya-cs: confirmed EU-only for subset, otherwise US ok. I'll mark that in the intake doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/intakes/quantico-1898765432 (client copy attached).

julie-cs: @sam-eng can you also add a smoke eval for safe-completion and a worst-case prompt injection test? quick test set will do.

sam-eng: yep. adding: prompt-injection, long-chain reasoning, and hallucination QA. Will post logs in results thread when done.

deploy-bot: Notice: bench job queued #q-442 — ETA ~3h.

maya-cs: great. I'll coordinate a short sync with Quantico for Wednesday to gather gold labels and clarify PHI fields. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

julie-cs: I'll draft the renewal risk note: flag = medium (needs on-prem + privacy attestation).

nora-privacy: will require a signed DPA addendum for PHI handling, plus an attestation from infra post-deploy.

sam-eng: logging action items: 1) infra bench (sam) 2) redaction probe + privacy tests (nora) 3) collect gold labels (maya) 4) draft runbook for EU-only routing (sam/julie). I'll create a follow-up thread with bench outputs.

maya-cs: thanks — keeping this thread for intake updates.
